_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta Hungador {player_id} den Tic Tac Toe.
Bo meta ta gana tres den un fila (horizontal, vertical, ò diagonal) ariba e tablero.
Na bo turno, bo mester selekta e numero di kuadro (0-8) ku bo ke pone bo marka den proximo.
Pa ehempel, '[4]' ta pone bo marka den e sel sentral di e tablero.
Komo Hungador {player_id}, bo lo ta '{symbol}', mientras bo oponente ta '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E moveshon presentá no ta sigui e forma korekto.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} no ta un cel valido. E mester ta entre 0 y 8.

game_action.placed: Hungador {player_id} a pone su simbolo ({symbol}) den sel {cell}.
